title: 14mm Triple Treat Glass VapCap Adapter
description:
14mm Triple Treat Glass VapCap Adapter
Ever thought one or even two dynavap tips is just not enough. Of course! strap up those boot laces and load up the Triple Treat.
The Triple Treat allows the use of 3 dynavap tips at once. And on the connection side you have a 14mm male glass joint which will connect to your favourite 14mm waterpipe.
Waterpipe and Dynavap Tips NOT Included
Included
1 X 14mm Triple Treat Glass VapCap Adapter
